name: text-analyzer
title: text-analyzer: one deterministic tokenizer shared by indexing and querying
interface:
Module `lib/analyze.mjs`.

```stub
export function tokenize(text: string): string[];
```

Semantics:
- Lowercases, Unicode-normalizes (NFD) and drops combining marks, so "Café" and "cafe"
  produce the same token.
- Emits the maximal runs of [a-z0-9] in order; every other character is a separator.
- Never emits an empty string; returns [] for "", for a non-string argument, and for
  input with no alphanumeric run.
- Deterministic and idempotent: tokenize(tokenize(x).join(" ")) deep-equals tokenize(x).
- It is the ONLY tokenizer in the project: the indexer and the query path must both
  call this function, so a document and a query are analysed identically.
nl_description: The analysis half of the search engine: the single function that turns arbitrary text — a document title, a document body, or a user query string — into comparable terms. Keeping exactly one tokenizer is what guarantees index terms and query terms are drawn from the same vocabulary; a second, slightly different tokenizer anywhere in the project is a defect, not an optimisation.
